target_semantics_lesson: The target is the monthly percentage change of the VIX index for a specific period, January 2024.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate evidence requirements for causal bridges. Test competing paths by assessing their supporting evidence and potential to dominate.
causal_reasoning_lesson: A VIX topping signal suggests a potential rise, supported by negative stock performance. However, historically flat January S&P 500 performance may moderate this.
counterevidence_lesson: Historically flat January S&P 500 performance acts as counterevidence, suggesting less extreme VIX movements than a topping signal might imply.
calibration_lesson: Reduce confidence when weak links exist. Assess if removing the weakest link would alter the conclusion.
